_note: Every cue is original and generated by the existing reproducible pipeline (tools/generate_audio.py). 'existing' = reuse an AudioCatalog key. Volumes are relative (0..1) to the SFX bus. maxPerSecond bounds stacking. Pitch ladders are in semitones from the cue root. `existing` must name a key in R/AudioCatalog.luau (validated). The first slice uses the subset in slice.json.

sfx.desc: soft glassy shimmer; pitch rises 0..+7 semitones as ribbon length goes 0..100, so the ear knows how much ribbon is left

sfx.trigger: head within 2x snapRadius of a snappable ribbon point
sfx.desc: two quick ascending ticks, like a zip about to catch

sfx.trigger: each creature popped by the cinch
sfx.desc: marimba pop; the Nth creature of a loop plays +N steps of a major pentatonic ladder (0,2,4,7,9,12,14,16), capped at 8
one bright bell per tech, layered as a chord (root, third, fifth, octave)

sfx.trigger: ribbon cut by Prickle / Static Puff / Antlume charge
sfx.desc: string snap + downward slide, 250ms; clearly different from whiff

sfx.trigger: dash start (client, same frame as input)
sfx.desc: airy burst with a pitched tail; second charge is +3 semitones
coin-fountain glissando whose length scales with parade size (0.3..1.2s) ending on a chord; FULL PARADE adds a choir pad
ascending arpeggio, one more note per tier

sfx.trigger: a wrap lands on a multi-wrap creature
sfx.desc: deep bell; each wrap a fourth higher; final wrap resolves

sfx.trigger: player dashes through a Static Puff
player launched by a mushroom cap

sfx.desc: low hoof rumble, sub-safe (high-passed at 60Hz for phone speakers)
warm two-note horn call: the game's audio logo
the stampede horn an octave lower with reverb tail
high twinkling loop, positional so players can find it by ear

sfx.trigger: local player inside a wind lane (loop)
sfx.desc: filtered wind with a tonal whistle

sfx.trigger: local player moving > 10 on ice (loop, pitch follows speed)

creatureVoices._rule: one 150-300ms voice per species, played spatially on startle (max 1 per creature per 2s, max 4 creature voices per second arena-wide), plus the telegraph sounds below
creatureVoices.sunshell: hollow 'tok' when tucking; rolling rumble when sliding
creatureVoices.prickle: tick, tick, TOCK turn counter (the telegraph)
creatureVoices.dunefin: sand hiss; bubbling at the next mound (the telegraph)
creatureVoices.starwhirl: pinwheel whirr rising before a blink (the telegraph)
creatureVoices.antlume: resonant bell-antler hum; snort + hoof scrape before the charge (the telegraph)

music._rule: Per arena: one 110s-synchronised piece built from 4 stacked stems that enter on the round beats, so the music IS the round clock. All stems share tempo/key and loop on 8-bar boundaries. Crossfades 1.5s. Existing 3 arena loops + finale layers map to stems A and D; stems B and C are new. Tempos equal the existing loops (112 / 105 / 90 bpm) so stems A and D can be the existing files.

stems.desc: driving toms/claps that build through the stampede telegraph and drop out at 70
octave-up counter melody + shaker; last 10s add a rising pedal tone

meadow.mood: sunny, bouncy; marimba, ukulele-like pluck, whistle lead

canyon.mood: galloping; twangy pluck, hand claps, slide lead

aurora.key: A minor -> C major on the finale
aurora.mood: sparkling, wide; glass bells, soft arp, sub pad

states.rule: 8-bar sting in the arena key then intermission state
add a tambourine sixteenths layer while the multiplier is x4
stem C continues through the legend window instead of dropping at 70

ambience.meadow: birdsong bed, creek trickle (spatial at creek), windmill creak (spatial)
ambience.canyon: dry wind, distant fizz of the falls (spatial), occasional pebble clatter
ambience.aurora: soft cold wind, faint glassy aurora drone, ice creaks on the lake (spatial, rare)

comfort: no cue exceeds -6 dBFS peak after bus gain
no cue has energy concentrated above 6 kHz for more than 150ms
repeated cues use +-1 semitone random pitch unless on a ladder
reduced-audio setting disables creature voices beyond 30 studs and the tambourine layer
